summary: Implemented command fragment buffering for split Telegram /new_goal and /repo_chat commands via new src/telegram/command-fragments.ts, wired buffer through bot.ts -> bot-native-commands.ts -> goal/repo-chat commands plus bot-handlers continuation capture, and added comprehensive tests in src/telegram/command-fragments.test.ts (unit + integration + createTelegramBot flows). Updated media test harness sendChatAction mock to return promises so existing suite remains valid. Verification passed: pnpm build, pnpm lint, pnpm vitest run src/telegram/command-fragments.test.ts, pnpm vitest run src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts, pnpm vitest run src/telegram/bot-native-commands.plugin-auth.test.ts, pnpm vitest run src/telegram/bot.media.downloads-media-file-path-no-file-download.test.ts. Goal CLI self-verification command path was exercised; initial run hit state-dir permission, rerun with MOLTBOT_STATE_DIR worked, and a bounded dry-run invocation returned planning-timeout output (planner did not complete in this environment).
